patch_description:
Replace the clipped ring construction with a dense, explicitly feasible 5-by-5 contact lattice plus a twenty-sixth circle in one of the lattice interstices. This alone has sum of radii approximately 2.5414: twenty-five radius-0.1 circles and one radius sqrt(0.02)-0.1 circle.

Starting from that strong geometric configuration, run a small deterministic SLSQP nonlinear program over both center positions and radii. The constraints directly encode all four square boundaries and every pairwise non-overlap condition, so it can exploit boundary shifts, unequal radii, and broken lattice symmetry. A final global radius safety scaling makes the returned result strictly feasible even if the numerical optimizer stops with tiny constraint residuals. If SciPy is unavailable or optimization fails, the explicit interstitial construction remains a valid high-quality fallback.
